thread:
oncall-bot: PAGER: latency.p99 for route /v1/chat/completions crossed 2.5s for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Severity: P2. Notifying @Sam W and @Priya R.
Sam W: I'm on it, joining the call.
Priya R: looking at traces now — appears concentrated in us-west-2.
Sam W: Confirmed. Pool pool-redwood-chat-2 queueing spike, CPU on a subset of GPUs at 95%.
Jun L: Is it tied to a specific model?
Priya R: 80% of the slow traces are Mistral-7b-v2 with long seq lengths (>1024). p95 is mostly stable, p99 is the tail.
Elena: Customers seeing UI freeze reports from a few PLG orgs. No errors, just latency.
Marcus: Paging noise? We've had similar tail behavior before during larger seq workloads.
Sam W: Quick mitigation: I'm going to enable routing fallback to mistral-7b-q4a for new requests routed to us-west-2 when observed queue_wait > 150ms. Rolling canary to 10% first.
Priya R: I'll watch traces and batch metrics. If batching wait drops, we should be good.
oncall-bot: DEPLOYBOT: route-override applied (canary=10%) by Sam W at 2026-03-15T15:34:12Z.
Sam W: Applied override. Initial effect: p99 dropped from ~3.2s to ~2.0s within 4 min.
Priya R: batch_wait went from 220ms -> 80ms after canary. KV cache hit unchanged.
Elena: Can we keep fallback until autoscaling catches up?
Sam W: I'll leave canary at 10% and open a quick autoscale request for pool-redwood-chat-2.
Marcus: Notifying support for customer comms. Low severity but visible UX impact.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: Mitigation reduced pager noise. Auto-pager suppressed.
---
Post-incident discussion (same thread):
Sam W: Action items from hotfix: the current single threshold (p99 > 2.5s) for /v1/chat/completions is too coarse given per-model latency characteristics. Propose: move to per-model p99 thresholds + add a sustained-count suppression to reduce noisy pages for known taily models.
Priya R: +1. Proposed per-model p99 baselines (first-pass):
  - mistral-7b-v2: 2.8s
  - mistral-7b-q4a: 1.8s
  - redwood-chat-3b: 1.2s
Rationale: different quantization/seq-length behavior and production histograms.
Jun L: Also recommend composite rule for critical customer impact: fire high-priority alert if BOTH p99 exceed per-model threshold AND error_rate > 0.5% OR sustained p99 exceed for 10m. Otherwise mark as P2 and suppress pager for short spikes.
Elena: We should surface the slow-tail histogram in the default SLO dashboard (0.5/0.95/0.99 + 99.9th). Suggest Grafana panels grouped by route->model->region.
Sam W: I'll open the alert PR. Draft alert snippet below (we'll refine):
```yaml
alert: ChatCompletions_PerModel_P99
expr: max by(model, region)(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_latency_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le, model, region))) > on(model) (
  label_replace(vector(per_model_threshold_seconds), "model", "$1", "model", "(.+)")
)
for: 5m
annotations:
  runbook: "\u003e\u003e https://redwood.internal/runbooks/chat_p99\nIf triggered: check pool queue lengths, batch_wait, fallback status, and recent deploys. Consider temporary routing override to q4a variant."
```
Priya R: We also need a short suppression policy to avoid pages from short-lived test traffic bursts. Something like: if p99 > threshold but duration < 3m and total_requests < 500 in the window, suppress paging and create low-priority ticket.
Marcus: +1. Also add per-route p95 alert for client-visible regressions: p95 > X (tbd) for 3m -> page if affects >5% of customers.
Jun L: Owners:
  - Sam W: PR to change alert rules to per-model p99 + suppression (ETA: today EOD).
  - Jun L: Add Grafana dashboard panels for per-model p95/p99 and tail histograms (ETA: +48h).
  - Elena: Update oncall runbook to include fallback + when to escalate (ETA: tomorrow).
  - Priya R: Run a replay of recent 30d latency histograms to recommend per-model thresholds (ETA: 24h).
Elena: Runbook snippet to be added (draft):
  - If ChatCompletions_PerModel_P99 triggers:
    1) Check region and model in panel -> if only one region affected, apply routing override and request autoscale.
    2) If >2 regions affected or error_rate > 0.5% -> escalate to P1 and notify infra-sre.
    3) For mitigation, prefer quick fallback to q4a variants over broad autoscale to reduce cost.
Sam W: One more: add an alert label that includes model and route so runbooks and dashboards can filter automatically.
Priya R: I'll collect model-specific histograms and post in this thread when ready.
Marcus: I'll create a short customer-facing blurb template for support based on whether it's mitigation or full outage.
Sam W: Thanks everyone. Quick retrospective tomorrow at 11:00 to decide final thresholds and suppression rules.
Elena: tagging product infra folks to make sure rule changes align with SLOs @product-infra (FYI).
Jun L: closing notes: prefer gradual rollouts of rule changes (canary on non-prod, then prod), and ensure alert burn-in period is monitored.
Sam W: last: please add your thumbs to the PR when you review :thumbsup:.
